title: Is Your PC Haunted? (A Fun 5-Question Tech Check)
subtitle: Answer honestly — at the end we'll tell you what's probably going on and how John can fix it. No email required.

questions.q: How fast does your computer feel these days?

options.t: I start it and go make lunch

questions.q: Pop-ups or weird messages appearing out of nowhere?
When did you last back up your photos & files?
How's your Wi-Fi at home or the shop?
What device are we talking about?

healthy.title: Healthy as a horse 🐎
healthy.blurb: Your machine is in good shape. Keep those backups running and you're golden. Swing by anyway — John loves talking shop.

tune.title: Needs a tune-up 🔧
tune.blurb: A little sluggish but nothing fatal. A good cleanup and a few tweaks often work wonders — John can have it running like new without a big parts bill.

sick.title: Definitely haunted 👻
sick.blurb: This one's crying for help — viruses, lost files, or a dying drive. Don't wait. Call John before it gets worse (and more expensive).

win.title: Windows box — John's bread & butter
win.blurb: Windows PCs are John's specialty. Whatever it's doing, he's fixed it a hundred times.

mac.title: Mac help? Yep, John does that too 🍎
mac.blurb: Despite the old rumor, John works on Macs — data, accounts, speed, and advice. Book an evening visit.

both.title: Mixed fleet — John handles all of it
both.blurb: Windows, Mac, Linux, networks. One call covers the whole house.
